justification: The Site Report page's 'email me this brief' capture (components/reports/PostResultEmailStrip.tsx, already wired into app/reports/intelligence-brief/page.tsx with product='intelligence-brief') has been posting to /api/canibuildit/lead since it shipped, but 'intelligence-brief' was never added to the route's Zod-enforced INTEREST_TYPES enum, so every submission 400'd. Confirmed live via browser network inspection: submitted a real address through the deployed Site Report, captured the actual XHR — status 400 — while the UI showed 'Thanks — we'll be in touch' regardless (that always-show-success behaviour is deliberate, tested design for graceful degradation on genuine transient failures, per PostResultEmailStrip.test.tsx's explicit 'Silent failure — never block the UX' comment; NOT touched here). Fix: add 'intelligence-brief' to INTEREST_TYPES + a branded buildEmailContent case. Also fixed a second bug found on read: the confirmation email's sender name and footer were hardcoded to the 'Can I Build It' consumer brand regardless of product, so an intelligence-brief email would have arrived From: PlotDetect with a 'Can I Build It? canibuildit.com.au' footer once the 400 was fixed — sender/footer now follow the product.

pre_impl.existing_data: Read PostResultEmailStrip.tsx (generic, reusable, already used by 3 callers: ThreatRadarTool, PropertyAlertsOptIn, intelligence-brief page) and its test suite before writing anything, to avoid duplicating existing lead-capture infrastructure (prior-art sweep). Confirmed via COMPONENT_MAP.md that CompleteSummary/the email strip are the correct, already-existing insertion points -- no new component needed, this is a bugfix not a feature build. Live-verified the 400 with a real submission (network tab) before touching code, and re-verified after the fix that the previously-broken value is now schema-accepted (unit test, since re-deploying to prod is out of scope for this session).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Initially assumed the email-capture feature did not exist and needed building. Prior-art sweep found it already existed and was already wired in -- the real problem was a silent server-side validation gap, not a missing feature. Also initially assumed the client's 'always show success' behaviour was an accidental silent-failure bug to fix; reading PostResultEmailStrip.test.tsx showed it is deliberate, tested UX policy for transient-failure graceful degradation across ALL callers (threat-radar, solar-yield, etc.) -- changing it would have broken 2 passing tests and reversed an intentional design decision. Left untouched; fixed only the actual root cause (the enum).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component, no new API route, no new DB table. Extends the existing INTEREST_TYPES enum (1 value) and existing buildEmailContent switch (1 case) in the existing, already-tested /api/canibuildit/lead route that 3 other features already depend on.

functions.name: POST
functions.input: JSON body incl. interest_type (now accepts 'intelligence-brief' as a 12th enum value)
functions.output: on valid input: stores the lead, computes a per-product from/replyTo/footer pair (intelligence-brief -> PlotDetect brand; every other existing product -> unchanged Can I Build It brand), sends the branded confirmation email, returns 200 {ok:true}
functions.if_none: interest_type outside the enum -> Zod safeParse fails -> 400 (unchanged behaviour for genuinely unknown values, e.g. 'nuclear-plant' -- still rejected, see lead-abuse.test.ts)

functions.name: buildEmailContent
functions.input: product identifier string (interest_type from the request body), plus the cleaned property address string
functions.output: for 'intelligence-brief': {subject: 'Your Site Report — <address>', body: links to verify.plotdetect.com.au/reports/intelligence-brief}; unchanged for all other existing product values
functions.if_none: unknown product string falls through to the existing default (granny-flat copy) -- pre-existing behaviour, unchanged

values.value: INTEREST_TYPES now includes 'intelligence-brief' (was missing -- this was the entire root cause of the 400)
values.if_missing: every Site Report 'email me this brief' submission 400s permanently; user sees a false success confirmation and never receives the email or gets stored as a lead (the exact bug this PR fixes)

values.value: per-product {fromLine, replyTo, footerLabel, footerUrl} -- PlotDetect brand for intelligence-brief, Can I Build It brand for every other product (unchanged)
values.if_missing: before this fix: hardcoded to the Can I Build It brand for ALL products -- an intelligence-brief email would arrive From: PlotDetect (once the 400 is fixed) with a mismatched 'Can I Build It? canibuildit.com.au' footer

break_it.scenario: A future developer adds a new product to PostResultEmailStrip's callers (a 4th interest_type) without adding it to the server's INTEREST_TYPES enum -- the exact mistake that caused this bug.
break_it.what_happens: Every submission for that product silently 400s while the client shows 'Thanks — we'll be in touch' (deliberate UX, see above) -- the lead is lost and nobody notices, because success is always shown regardless of the real HTTP status.
break_it.how: Not structurally preventable without changing the deliberate client UX (out of scope, would break tested behaviour) -- but the fix here demonstrates the failure mode explicitly (lead-abuse.test.ts already has a live 'rejects unknown interest_type with 400' test) so the pattern is documented and a future PR review can catch a new caller whose product string isn't in the enum. The comment added at INTEREST_TYPES' first use in this PR names this exact class of bug for the next person extending it.
break_it.repro: add a 4th PostResultEmailStrip call site with a product value not in INTEREST_TYPES, submit via the UI, observe the UI says success while the network tab shows 400 -- reproduces the exact bug this PR fixes for a 4th time

break_it.scenario: The per-product from/replyTo/footer branch only checks interest_type === 'intelligence-brief'; a typo or new value silently falls to the else branch (Can I Build It brand).
break_it.what_happens: A genuinely new PlotDetect-brand (not canibuildit-brand) product added later would silently get the wrong sender/footer instead of erroring -- a branding bug, not a data-loss bug (email still sends and lead still stores).
break_it.how: Lower severity than the original bug (cosmetic, not silent data loss) and consistent with how buildEmailContent's own switch/default already works in this file. Two regression tests lock the current behaviour for both branches (intelligence-brief brand AND the unchanged canibuildit brand for granny-flat), so any future change to this branch is caught by CI.
break_it.repro: pytest -- N/A (frontend); npx jest __tests__/api/canibuildit/lead-abuse.test.ts -- both brand tests must stay green

break_it.scenario: PostResultEmailStrip's client-side 'always show success' behaviour (untouched by this PR) could mask a FUTURE regression the same way it masked this one.
break_it.what_happens: Any server-side failure on this endpoint -- a new validation rule, a Supabase outage, a Resend key rotation -- would again show 'Thanks' to every user while silently losing their email, with no client-visible signal.
break_it.how: Deliberately NOT changed in this PR -- it is tested, intentional design (PostResultEmailStrip.test.tsx: 'Silent failure — never block the UX') shared by 3 callers, and changing it is a UX/product decision outside this bugfix's scope, not something to change unilaterally.
break_it.repro: n/a -- documented as a known, accepted tradeoff, not something this PR claims to fix

break_it.scenario: Before this fix, the canibuildit_leads insert (unchanged code, line 177) was never reached for intelligence-brief submissions -- Zod validation 400'd before execution ever got there, so the insert's own correctness was never in question, only its reachability.
break_it.what_happens: Reachability, not query logic, was the defect -- a perfectly correct insert that silently never ran for this one interest_type, so no leads with interest_type='intelligence-brief' exist in canibuildit_leads from before this fix.
break_it.how: The new happy-path test ('accepts interest_type intelligence-brief and returns ok:true') exercises the full route including this insert with the mocked Supabase client, confirming the call now reaches and passes through the existing insert path unchanged.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required -- no schema change, only a Zod enum extension. canibuildit_leads already has the columns this write needs.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- after deploy, submit a real address through verify.plotdetect.com.au/reports/intelligence-brief's 'Email me' strip and confirm (a) the network request now returns 200, (b) the confirmation email arrives From: PlotDetect <info@plotdetect.com.au> with a PlotDetect-branded footer linking to verify.plotdetect.com.au, and (c) the lead appears in canibuildit_leads with interest_type='intelligence-brief'.
